name: Root canal therapy
title: Root canal treatment in Edmonton, Cairns | South Cairns Dental
description: Root canal therapy treats a tooth whose nerve is irreversibly inflamed or has died, with the aim of keeping your natural tooth. South Cairns Dental, Edmonton.

hero.title: Root canal therapy
hero.lead: When the nerve inside a tooth is badly inflamed or has died, root canal treatment can often save the tooth rather than removing it.

intro.heading: Saving your natural tooth
intro.html:
Root canal treatment removes the inflamed or infected tissue from inside the tooth, cleans the canals and seals them. The aim is to relieve pain and infection and keep your own tooth in place.

Not every tooth can be saved, and your dentist will explain the likely outcome for yours, along with the alternatives.
intro.aside_heading: Signs a tooth may need assessment
aside: Pain that lingers after hot or cold food
Pain when biting or touching the tooth
Swelling or a pimple on the gum near a tooth
A tooth that has darkened after an injury

callout.title: Worried about discomfort?
callout.html: Treatment is carried out under local anaesthetic. Tell your dentist how you’re feeling at any point; you can ask to stop for a break.

explain.heading: Why a tooth might need it
explain.intro: Inside every tooth is soft tissue containing the nerve. Two common causes of damage:

items.title: Deep decay
items.text: Decay that reaches the centre of the tooth can inflame or infect the nerve.

items.title: Injury
items.text: A knock or crack can damage the nerve, sometimes long before you notice symptoms.

process.heading: What treatment involves
process.intro: The number of appointments varies from tooth to tooth. Your dentist will explain the plan for yours.
steps: Your dentist examines the tooth and takes X-rays to see the roots.
The damaged nerve tissue is removed and the canals inside the root are cleaned.
The space is filled and sealed to help keep bacteria out.
Your dentist will advise whether the tooth needs a filling or a crown to protect it.

weigh.heading: Benefits and things to consider
benefits: Can relieve pain caused by an inflamed or infected nerve
Keeps your natural tooth, which helps your bite
Avoids the gap left by an extraction
consider: Treatment may need more than one appointment
The tooth may need a crown afterwards to protect it
Some teeth don’t respond and may need further treatment or removal
alternatives: Extraction, then replacing the tooth with an implant, bridge or denture
Referral to a specialist endodontist for complex cases

care.heading: Before and after your appointment
items: Avoid chewing hard food on the tooth until it’s fully restored.
Tenderness for a few days is common. Call us if you have swelling or pain that gets worse.
Have the final filling or crown placed as recommended, so the tooth doesn’t crack.

faqs: It’s carried out under local anaesthetic, and most people feel pressure rather than pain. The treatment is often what relieves the toothache.
Back teeth in particular are often crowned after root canal treatment to protect them. Your dentist will advise on your tooth.
Can I just take painkillers and wait?
Pain relief may ease symptoms but doesn’t treat the cause. An untreated infection can spread, so please book an assessment.
cost: The cost depends on what your mouth needs, so it can only be worked out after an examination.
